create_vimeo90k_dataset_train: create a Vimeo90kSeptuplet dataset using the train split with all 7 frames per septuplet
create_vimeo90k_dataset_video_mode: create a Vimeo90kSeptuplet dataset in video mode that returns stacked tensors of consecutive frames
create_vimeo90k_dataset_custom_frames: create a Vimeo90kSeptuplet dataset with a custom number of frames per group between 1 and 7
load_image_from_septuplet: load a single image from a septuplet folder by frame number using the load_image method
getitem_vimeo90k_dataset: get an item from the Vimeo90kSeptuplet dataset by index returning either a single image or stacked video frames
